intro: Iran has some of the world's largest oil and gas reserves, but sanctions have held its economy back.

chapters.title: Oil and gas
text: Iran has the world's second-largest gas reserves and huge oil reserves. Oil has long paid for much of the government's budget.
International sanctions over its nuclear programme have limited oil exports, caused high inflation and weakened the currency, the rial.

chapters.title: Beyond oil
text: Iran makes cars, steel and petrochemicals, and is famous for pistachios, saffron, carpets and caviar. It produces most of the world's saffron.
